bio: Few dining experiences compare to Eastwell Manor, a breathtaking luxury hotel nestled within the rolling countryside of Kent, where Afternoon Tea is as gorgeous as the surroundings.  Take your pick of Eastwell Manor's two beautiful lounges or, enjoy your Afternoon Tea on the garden terrace if the weather permits it.  Afternoon Tea is served with a pot of loose-leaf tea of your choice, plus a selection of freshly cut mini sandwiches and savouries. Next, tuck into warm scones with clotted cream and homemade jam, finished with sweet treats of beautifully-presented petit fours and your choice from an exceptional range of speciality teas to perfectly accompany your food. From gently-perfumed jasmine and refreshing green to soothing peppermint and classic early grey, dining here is all about luxury and choice.
